What are some tips and tricks for programming for Enhancement Suite?

Sorry for the delay! I'm writing this quickly while Voat's up...

I started with microcontroller programming! VEX robotics. Anyway, there really aren't many tricks to program for VES; in essence it's a JavaScript file. The only real "tip" I can think of is have a good set of dev tools and a decent text editor with JavaScript/jQuery syntax highlighting.

Sublime Text 3 with Package Control is my editor of choice, and for Chrome I use the built-in Chrome Dev tools and HTML5 Storage Manager. My Firefox add-ons consists of Firebug and FireStorage, but not much of my time goes into testing on Firefox, to be honest...CodePen is where I go whenever I'm testing out new CSS (I have the VES Settings menu prototyped there, but it's seriously outdated) and for minor JavaScript fiddling.

Welcome to extension development! If I come up with any more "tips" I'll try to post them around here somewhere. There's a lot of refining that needs to be done to the source, but you're welcome to contribute however much you're comfortable with.
